summary: Completed both backend (pytest, 13/13 passing) and frontend (Playwright) testing of the AMASS content-driven landing + API-key-protected Admin API. All admin auth variants (X-API-Key and Bearer), stats, filters, newsletter, lead PATCH (valid/invalid/404), and CMS update+reset flows pass. Public /api/content returns content doc. Frontend: hero/stats/testimonials/FAQ are rendered from content API, lead-form dialog + submit success, footer newsletter subscribe success. No console errors. Content was reset to defaults at end of tests.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_update_content performs a top-level $set which replaces entire nested objects (e.g. PUT {hero:{line1:'x'}} would wipe other hero fields like line2/line3). The test passes only because reset is called after. Consider deep-merging nested dicts if partial updates are desired.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject; acceptable for API-key machine-to-machine but worth noting.
No rate limiting on public /api/leads and /api/newsletter — potential spam vector.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ leads and newsletter signups via public endpoints during tests. Not cleaned up (small volume, no delete endpoint exposed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend admin API & CMS fully working. Reset endpoint restores DEFAULT_CONTENT. Note partial-update caveat on PUT /api/admin/content (replaces nested keys at top level).
